title: Repurposed marble dust as a promising adsorbent for modelling the removal of methylene blue from aqueous solutions
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, 3,946-962
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00594E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ankita Sharma, Subrata Panda, Sudesh Kumar, Yogesh Chandra Sharma
This investigation scrutinizes the facile preparation of a non-complex, low-cost, sustainable, and industrially feasible adsorbent along with conducting its mechanistic studies, followed by its implementation in the removal of MB dye.
